sanskrit: skandanandigaṇākīrṇaṃ viśveśvarasamanvitam mahodarasamāyuktamapsarobhiḥ samāvṛtam gandharvādi gaṇopetaṃ siddhasaṅghaiśca saṃyutam nārada pramukhaiścaiva gītanṛttaviśāradaiḥ sarvānugrahakartāraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam tatrasthaṃ devadeveśamumayāsahitaṃ śivam saṃśayā viṣṭacittastu candro vedavidāṃpatiḥ rodamāno bravīdvākyamucchasaṃśca punaḥ punaḥ || mohitaṃ māyayā sarvaṃ brahāṇḍaṃ sa carācaram sarveṣāṃ niścitā buddhiḥ praṇaṣṭā iti me matiḥ tvayoktasyaiva candrasya buddhi rūpasya nityaśaḥ svayamevamasaunaṣṭaścintayāyaḥ prakalpitaḥ prayuktā ca yathā vīṇā tantrīsvara samanvitā tathā mantrā tadākārā vidyāścaiva sahasraśaḥ kṛtake naiva santuṣṭā bhrāmitā māyayā punaḥ uccāryamāṇā ye mantrā na te samyak tvayoditāḥ p. 56b) māyāsvapnopamāḥ sarve mudrādhyanādi dhāraṇāḥ devyā vināyakasyaiva ṣaṇmukhasya trilocanam vāsukirgāruḍaścaiva brahmaṇo viṣṇurudrayoḥ durvāsapramukhādīnāṃ munīnāṃ yastu saṃhitaḥ saṃprāptāvividhākārā vidyāścāpi sahasraśaḥ tatsantuṣṭa mahādeva śirassthena mayā śrutam na jñātaṃ kasyacijjñānaṃ śārīraṃ gūḍhagocaram kṛtakaṃ naiva santuṣṭāḥ svacittamuṣitāḥ sthitāḥ sambhāvaṃ kasyacennoktaṃ mohitāḥ paramārthikāḥ

dīyate kasya vā piṇḍaṃ vāyurvāyau pralīyate ākāśe tu tathākāśaṃ manobuddhirahaṃ tathā ko yaṃ māṃsa mayo deho dagdho vā prāṇibhakṣitaḥ na rūpaṃ tasya no varṇo na sthānaṃ na ca dhāraṇā narakāśśāsanāścaiva pretapuṇyaṃ vasetakaḥ nīyante bahubhiḥkālaireko vā kiṃ bahūnnayet lakṣasaṅkhyāśca vahavastatra kālaḥkimāgataḥ nīyante bahubhiḥ kiṃ vā etatsarvaṃ vadasva me yanna kasya cidākhyātaṃ nissaṃśaya karaṃparam tāneśa parameśāna mohanyuktā tu mātṛkā saṃbhavanti yathovarṇāḥ svaravyañjanasaṃjñakāḥ tasyādhikāraṇaṃ yat tad vāgbhirvaktuṃ na śakyate tajjñātvā bījarājaṃ tu varuṇānalamadhyagam parivārāṅga vistāraṃ nāmajāti vivarjitam śabdāvasthaṃ parityajya bodharūpeṇasaṃsthitam asvaraṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ yogināṃ mokṣadaṃ dhruvam śaśadhavaravidyāṃ ca muhūrtadinarātribhiḥ kīlanāddvijarājaivamevaṃ kālobhidhīyate nīyate dehasaṃsthena karmaṇākālarūpiṇā sukhaduḥkha phalaṃ bhuṅkte jīvaḥ svasyaivakarmaṇaḥ āyuḥ kṣīṇāśca ye bhūtāstiryañcomānuṣāḥ surāḥ na dveṣānna ca vairāgyāṅkālaḥ karmedamucyate kiṃ vidhau devadeveśa jīvonāmamaheśvara kathaṃ kālaḥ praśamati jīva sthāne trilocana śṛṇu tāvat pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ bhuvi durlabham

śaktigarbha sthito nityaṃ rūpaṃ dhyānavivarjitam p. 59b) upamānavaśaścandra śṛṇu pātrastu kalpitaḥ trividhaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ śāktogrā kārakaḥ smṛtaḥ sarvopamānarahitaḥ kalpanā kālavarjitaḥ guṇātmikā tu vijñeyā prakṛtistattva rūpiṇī eṣā prakṛtirutpanā saṃsthitā sarva dehiṣu etacchrutvā dhva?hāsena candro vedavidāṃbaraḥ p. 60a) pañcabhūtātmakaṃ piṇḍaṃ pañcasthāna gataṃ prabho ye ye bhāvā yathā yātāstathā tatra layaṃ gatāḥ sarvajñasaṃśayasyāsya kiṃ bravihi vinirṇayam mūrtairbrahmādibhiścaiva vedarājayamena ca ātmārthaṃ racitaṃ śāstraṃ kriyākāṇḍamanuttamam prajārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvanopāya hetukam p. 60b) annena jīvalokoyaṃ vartate sarvasambhavaḥ śrāddhadānādikaṃ karma na ca piṇḍodaka kriyā kutaḥ piṇḍaṃ kutaḥ śrāddhaṃ kutodāhādi lakṣaṇam sthiti kāraṇahetuṃ tvādbhūtā * * *? ta saṃskṛtam svakarmaṇā sukhaṃ bhuṅkte duḥkhaṃ bhuṅkte svakarmaṇā yena yena svabhāvena prakṛtisthāṃ tyajet tanum p. 61a) jīvaḥ saṃsarate dehānna cāsau mriyate punaḥ na naṣṭaścaiva notpanno baddho mukto na cāpyasau na kṛtirguṇapāśaistu veṣṭitāssarvadehinām yena bhāvena yo tyantaḥ prakṛtergacchate punaḥ jīvo dvandva vinirmuktaḥ sarvakarmasusaṃsthitaḥ yathā vṛtau gatau vāyuḥ saṃsthitasya dvijeśvara

p. 61b) tatrasthaṃ yatparaṃ śūnyaṃ candrajīvaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ yat tat tattvadharaṃ śūnyaṃ sa kathaṃ caiva naśyati sahasā ca ghaṭe bhinne na vāyurvidyate kvacit darpaṇānanasaṃyoga jalārka pratibimbite jalakṣayādyathā cārko naiva naśyati vai kvacit sarvagaḥ sarvakartā ca sarvadvandva bahiṣkṛtaḥ puṣpairgandhai tilaistailaṃ kṣīre sarpistato nalaḥ śakterabhyantare jīvaḥ saṃsthito naiva lipyate catuṣkena pranaṣṭe tu tannabho naiva naśyati na tasya kālo mṛtyurvā na piṇḍaḥ śrāddhalakṣaṇam etacchrutvādyavai candraḥ praphultakamalekṣaṇaḥ mānaṃ tu karaṇaṃ tasya pramāṇaṃ vada bhairava prāṇāpānapravāhena gacchate viśate punaḥ guṇāḥ sarve sthitāstasyā uparāgāmaṇeriva tena tena svabhāvena tatra tatrāvatiṣṭhate darpaṇe ca yathā cchāyā jalamadhye tu tārakāḥ karmaṇā svena bhāvena taṃ tu bhuñjanti dehinaḥ evaṃ śaktikanirjīvaḥ sukhadohlādakaḥ smṛtaḥ kālāgnyādi śivāntaṃ ca yadrūpaṃ kiñcid dṛśyate aśmāntaragataścaiva asthirandhraśca saṃsthitaḥ rahasyaṃ tedya vakṣyāmi ekāgraḥ śṛṇu tatparaḥ vāyuścakhaṃmanobuddhirahaṅkāraśca ye guṇāḥ yat kiñcit sakalaṃ bhāvaṃ rūpataḥ keṣusaṃsthitam bhrāntiṃ tyaja sa vai putra sarvaṃ śūnye pratiṣṭhitam varṇebhyaśca tathā mantrā mantrebhyaḥ sṛṣṭiravyayā

yugādinā tato adya nityaṃ sada sataḥ param nāyaṃ piṇḍesti na śrāddhaṃ na kālakalanā tathā bhūtagrāmeṣu sarveṣu śaktyantarvasate prabhuḥ sthitaṃ tadeva bhāṇḍāsthaṃ sarvasya varavarṇakam jñānabhedo na vidyeta teṣāṃ śāstrāgameṣu ca prakṛtirnāmadeveśa ādhāradharaṇī yathā na naṣṭā na ca saṃbhrāntiradyāpi parameśvara saro madhye ca patitā galitā ekatāṃ gatāḥ nirguṇatvaṃ guṇaṃ yasya arūpaṃ caiva rūpakam tena sarvamidaṃ vyāptamābrahmabhuvanāntikam āṇavaṃ ca tathā śāktaṃ bindunādātmakaṃ ca yat sarvaśivamayaṃ candra śivo jīvaḥ prakīrtitaḥ adhyātmajñānasambodhaṃ śaktigarbhaṃ tu yo bhyaset ajarāmarabhūto vai bhavate nātrasaṃśayaḥ karmaṇāṃ caiva mahato guṇānāṃ bhūtajastathā idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathayāmi tavākhilam p. 65a) paśutvaṃ ca patitvaṃ ca dvau bhedau ca śarīriṇām yathābhrairarkaraśmibhyo darpaṇaṃ ca malena ca ajñānāddṛśyate janturguṇapāśaistu yantritaḥ na deho mriyate bhuṅkte karmabhogeti tasya vai prāpnoti jñānamabhyāsājjñānānmuktastu mocakaḥ sarvagaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ hetūpādhivivarjitam p. 65b) vipro vā mūḍhabuddhiśca ajñāna spṛśya eva saḥ tasya hastā tu vai grāhya sa ca pūjyo yathā hyaham ajñānācca kriyākāṇḍaṃ jñānāt karmakṣayo bhavet

ajñānāt karmapāśaistu prakṛtairbadhyate punaḥ sarvaṃ jagat svadehaṃ vā parānandena pūritam na kālo na yamaḥ kaścidetā bāla vibhīṣakāḥ p. 66a) kutaḥ kālaḥ kuto mṛtyurnarake śāsanāḥ katham kāyaṃ śūnyamayaṃ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi carcayet guṇapāśairnibadhyante mūḍhāḥ pāparatāḥ punaḥ tatra tatrājñā bhāvatvaṃ paśūnāṃ syāt sadodūpa yadi jīvo hi muktaśca nīrūpaḥ khasvarūpakaḥ etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tvat pramādāt kapāla bhṛt prakṛtirguṇasaṃpūrṇā mriyate jāyate tathā na jīvo bhuñjate karma na cāsau prakṛtirguṇaiḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvagodhyakṣaḥ kharūpī khamanaḥ khagaḥ te pi pra?mohamāpannā jīvaṃ jñānavidhau sadā pravṛtyarthaṃ tu bhūtānāṃ prakṛtārthamasaṃsthitaḥ p. 67a) ādhāradharaṇī śaktiraśirāhaṃ sa rūpiṇī yathā veśmāntara gataṃ nabhaḥ sarvagataṃ sthitam tad vat sarvagataṃ brahma sarvatraiva susaṃsthitam tārakendra tyajabhrāntiṃ kimanyat kathayāmite tvat prasādānmayājñātaṃ jīvalakṣaṇamuttamam adya jātosmyahaṃ deva jñānenānena bhairava toṣito vai mahādevaścandreṇa ca yathā kṛtaḥ jñānabhogī ca madvākyāt pūrvoktamyā mṛtodbhava evamuktvā yadā devo virarāma maheśvaraḥ bhaktāyedaṃ pradātavyaṃ śraddhādānāya dhīmate sa mūḍhaḥ sarvadā tiṣṭedātmajñānenasaṃyutaḥ
